Hymn 110: Cast Thy Burden upon the Lord
Time Signature: 4/4

This is hymn number 110 titled "Cast Thy Burden upon the Lord" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Alexander Schreiner and the lyrics were written by Philip Doddridge.
